name: hubspot
title: HubSpot CRM API
description: Contacts, companies, deals, tickets, emails, and CRM pipelines.
notes: Requires HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN (private app token) from app.hubspot.com/private-apps. Each HubSpot object (contacts, deals, companies) has its own spec — this loads Contacts. Use load_api with other spec URLs for additional objects.
